title: Drone attacks on power stations
description: RSF drone strikes on power infrastructure left cities without electricity and caused civilian casualties.

title: ASEAN leaders gather; code‑of‑conduct agreement seen as unlikely
description: During an ASEAN summit, analysts noted that reaching a final South China Sea code of conduct will be a tall order given the heightened tensions between China and the Philippines.

title: US envoys meet Zelensky in Dublin
description: US envoy Steve Witkoff met President Zelensky in Dublin after talks with Putin in Moscow; Putin agreed to allow European negotiators to join the next round of Ukraine talks.

title: Russian hospital bombing injures 73
description: A Russian airstrike hit a Ukrainian hospital, injuring at least 73 people.

title: SAF successes in Kordofan
description: UN identified Kordofan as the conflict’s epicentre as SAF gains ground against RSF.

title: Gulf allies urge pause; IRGC hits radar
description: Saudi Arabia, Qatar and other Gulf states asked the U.S. to hold off large‑scale attacks; the IRGC retaliated by hitting a U.S. early‑warning radar in Bahrain.

title: Israeli strike on Nasser Hospital
description: Killed at least six people

title: Xi Jinping’s statement on reunification
description: President Xi declared that Taiwan’s “complete reunification” with China will happen, reaffirming Beijing’s long‑term goal despite not explicitly mentioning the use of force.

title: Seoul summons Ukraine’s envoy over North Korean POW transfer
description: South Korea protested the secret handover of two captured North Korean soldiers, accusing Kyiv of destabilising the peninsula.

title: Trump meets Qatar mediator
description: Trump met Qatar’s mediator in Doha; officials said no imminent deal, while mutual attacks continued, including a U.S. strike on Qeshm Island and Iranian attacks on tankers.

title: US strikes Qeshm Island; Iran attacks tankers in Gulf and Strait of Hormuz
description: The United States conducted an airstrike on Iran’s Qeshm Island, and Iranian forces responded by targeting commercial tankers navigating the Gulf and the Strait of Hormuz. President Trump reiterated U.S. readiness to strike Iran if needed while acknowledging diplomatic momentum, with Qatar mediating talks but no immediate cease‑fire agreement.

title: IS‑linked attack in Cantine, North Kivu
description: Burned vehicles and homes were reported after militants affiliated with the Islamic State attacked the town.

title: IS‑affiliated attack in Cantine, North Kivu
description: Militants linked to the Islamic State set fire to vehicles and homes in Cantine, North Kivu, causing extensive damage.

title: Land‑mine explosions injure three South Korean soldiers
description: Explosions on the western edge of the DMZ wounded three troops, reigniting tensions over the 1953 armistice line.

title: South Korea and U.S. conclude joint “Hoguk” military exercises
description: The two‑week drill involved combined forces and multilateral “Keen Sword” exercises in Japan, underscoring allied readiness.

title: China warns against “provocative acts” after Philippine deployment
description: Beijing issued a warning, labeling the Philippine Coast Guard’s actions as provocative and reiterating its claim to the contested waters.

title: Philippine Coast Guard deploys largest vessel to challenge Chinese research ship near Batanes
description: The Philippine Coast Guard sent its biggest vessel, supported by aircraft, to confront a Chinese research vessel operating near the northern province of Batanes; the Chinese vessel subsequently withdrew.

title: Diplomats meet at the UN General Assembly sidelines
description: Iranian and US-aligned officials hold talks in New York, without a breakthrough on the frozen ceasefire.

title: Trump meets Rodríguez as Machado again fails to return
description: Their first face-to-face meeting since the raid coincides with Machado’s seventh set of failed attempts to re-enter Venezuela.

title: US envoys shuttle between Moscow and Kyiv
description: Witkoff and Kushner hold talks in both capitals; a brief pause ends with renewed strikes on Kyiv.

title: Hemedti sworn in to head a rival government in Nyala
description: RSF commander "Hemedti" is formally sworn in as head of the parallel "Tasis" administration, edging Sudan toward partition.

title: China fires water cannon at Philippine vessels
description: Chinese coast guard ships target Philippine boats near Scarborough Shoal for a second straight day.

title: Twin earthquakes strike Venezuela
description: A major double earthquake compounds the humanitarian crisis and becomes a political flashpoint during the transition.

title: Israel and Iran exchange fire again as ceasefire frays
description: A fresh round of direct strikes breaks out, drawing in US forces before another pause is announced.

title: Min Aung Hlaing elected president
description: Myanmar’s junta chief wins a parliamentary vote 429-126, formalizing military rule behind a civilian title.

title: Sudan’s army recaptures Khartoum
description: SAF forces retake the capital, consolidating control over central and eastern Sudan.

title: Mojtaba Khamenei named Iran’s new Supreme Leader
description: The Assembly of Experts names Khamenei’s son as his successor, the first hereditary transition in the Islamic Republic’s history.

title: US-Israeli strikes kill Iran’s Supreme Leader
description: A major air campaign, reported as "Operation Epic Fury," kills Ali Khamenei and other senior officials, triggering a wider war.

title: Ethiopia and Eritrea deploy troops to the border
description: Both countries move military equipment toward their shared border amid fears of renewed war.

title: North Korea’s first missile test of the year
description: The launch comes hours after the US raid on Maduro — a scenario North Korea’s leadership has long feared for itself.

title: US raid captures Maduro
description: US special forces seize Nicolás Maduro and his wife, flying them to the US to face narco-terrorism charges.

title: New ceasefire after the deadliest fighting in years
description: Three weeks of artillery, tank and drone warfare killed 100+ people before a fresh truce took hold.

title: Thailand launches new offensive and blocks fuel supplies
description: Thailand began a fresh military offensive, halted fuel shipments to Cambodia and, together with Cambodia’s closure of all border crossings, escalated the humanitarian crisis.

title: Fighting enters fifth day and UN warns of civilian risk
description: Renewed combat near historic temples marked the fifth day of clashes, with the UN rights chief warning that strikes were moving further into each side’s territory and endangering civilians.

title: El-Fasher falls to the RSF
description: RSF forces capture El-Fasher after a long siege, consolidating control over Darfur.

title: Gaza ceasefire takes effect
description: A US-brokered ceasefire built around Trump’s 20-point plan begins, though violence continues intermittently.

title: JNIM declares a fuel blockade of Bamako
description: Al-Qaeda-linked militants begin systematically attacking fuel convoys headed for Mali’s capital.

title: U.S.-brokered summit
description: Leaders met in August 2025, issuing a joint peace declaration and initialing a peace agreement that envisages a transit corridor.

title: Armenia and Azerbaijan sign a peace framework
description: At the White House, both countries sign a preliminary deal including the US-run TRIPP transit corridor.

title: U.S.–brokered summit and joint peace declaration
description: Leaders of Armenia and Azerbaijan met in August 2025, issuing a joint peace declaration and initialing a peace agreement that outlines a transit corridor and steps toward normalising relations.

title: First ceasefire after a 5-day border clash
description: Malaysia-brokered truce ends five days of fighting that killed dozens and displaced hundreds of thousands.

title: Israel and Iran fight a direct 12-day war
description: Israel strikes Iranian nuclear and military sites; Iran retaliates with missile barrages before a ceasefire holds.

title: US-brokered ceasefire ends India-Pakistan fighting
description: After days of missile, drone and artillery exchanges, Trump announces a ceasefire; both sides confirm it hours later.

title: Attack on tourists in Pahalgam kills 26
description: A militant attack on Hindu tourists in Indian-administered Kashmir triggers the worst India-Pakistan crisis in decades.

title: M23 soldiers gather in Goma
description: M23 fighters were seen at the Stade de l’Unite’ in Goma for a public gathering.

title: Hamas attack on Israel starts the Gaza war
description: Hamas-led fighters attack southern Israel; Israel launches a sustained military campaign in Gaza in response.

title: Azerbaijan’s September 2023 offensive
description: Azerbaijan launched a large‑scale offensive that dissolved the Nagorno‑Karabakh enclave and displaced over 100,000 Armenians.

title: Azerbaijan’s September 2023 offensive
description: Azerbaijani forces launched a large‑scale offensive that broke the stalemate, leading to the dissolution of the Nagorno‑Karabakh enclave and the displacement of more than 100,000 ethnic Armenians.

title: War erupts between SAF and RSF
description: Fighting breaks out in Khartoum between the army and the Rapid Support Forces, beginning Sudan’s civil war.

title: Russia launches full-scale invasion
description: Russian forces invade Ukraine on multiple fronts, beginning the largest war in Europe since 1945.

title: Ceasefire ending 2020 war
description: A Russia‑brokered ceasefire took effect in the early hours of 10 November 2020, ending the deadliest fighting.
